title: LED on GPIO34 never turns on
serial_logs:
I (312) cpu_start: Starting scheduler on PRO CPU.
I (0) cpu_start: Starting scheduler on APP CPU.
I (322) gpio: GPIO[34]| InputEn: 0| OutputEn: 1| OpenDrain: 0| Pullup: 0| Pulldown: 0| Intr:0
user_question: Code builds and runs without errors but the LED on GPIO34 never lights. Wiring checked.

reference_context.title: ESP32 Series Datasheet (Espressif)
reference_context.snippet: GPIO34, GPIO35, GPIO36 (SENSOR_VP) and GPIO39 (SENSOR_VN) are input-only pins. They have no output drivers and no internal pull-up or pull-down resistors.

expected.root_cause: GPIO34 is an input-only pin on the ESP32 and has no output driver, so it can never drive the LED.
root_cause_keywords: cannot (be used as|drive|act as)( an)? output
expected.fix: Move the LED to an output-capable GPIO such as GPIO2, GPIO4 or GPIO25 and update LED_PIN.
